name: OpenRewriteEval
description: OpenRewriteEval is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on diverse text rewriting tasks expressed through natural language instructions, covering a wide variety of rewriting types beyond single sentences.
reputation: A newer benchmark that has seen some use in evaluating instruction-based rewriting, but it is not yet as widely established as major general-purpose NLP benchmarks.
notes: Benchmark covers cross-sentence rewriting tasks using natural language instructions; uses instruction tuning and reinforcement learning strategies.
